idea-plugin.name: Daakia
idea-plugin.description: An IntelliJ plugin designed to streamline API development directly within the IntelliJ IDE. It offers a comprehensive set of features to manage and test the rest APIs seamlessly, all without leaving your development environment.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v4.0.0 - Support for Intellij Unified Distribution Added v3.0.9 — SideNav history bug fixes —Fixed issue with a history panel not updating correctly in sidenav mode —Improved UI responsiveness when toggling sidenav mode
v3.0.0 - Major UI & Panel Management Enhancements — Double-click divider to dynamically resize panels (maximize left, reset, maximize right) — Improved panel visibility toggling and divider thresholds — Refactored request/response panel handling: hide response content when collapsed, smooth state restoration — Enhanced trash panel: restore and permanent delete actions, ancestor/parent folder restoration — Improved collection management: new DbTreeStoreService, fixed empty folder save, improved import/export — UI refinements: built—in editor for user input, adaptive layouts, async request progress bar, removed unused buttons
v2.0.4 — Persistent debug mode and script log settings via DaakiaSettings — About dialog now remembers Script/GraalVM checkbox state — Debug tab created on EDT, shows logs instantly — Tabs for History, Collection, and Environment always created on the Swing thread — Improved stability and UI responsiveness with ApplicationManager.invokeLater
v2.0.3 — Scripts Tab: Added pre—request and post—request script editors (JavaScript) — Environment Variable Scripting: Support for modifying environment variables via daakia.setGlobalEnvVar — Authorization Enhancements: Auth headers resolve environment variable placeholders (e.g., {{token}}) — GraalVM Migration: Replaced Nashorn with GraalVM for JavaScript execution — Postman Compatibility: Import/export includes auth headers and script events — Persistence: Script content saved with history and collection records
v2.0.2 — Added SQLite persistence layer and DAO classes — Created Postman import/export utilities for collections — Implemented environment and variable data models with management UI — Enhanced plugin with GraphQL request support — Refined environment panel layout and text box alignment — Added dynamic row management for environment variables — Introduced placeholder—enabled PasswordInputField and updated authorization panel layout — Bug fixes and enhancements
v1.0.x — v1.0.8: Search text functionality in collection and history panel — v1.0.7: Multipart—form data support — v1.0.6: Minor bug fixes and UI polish — v1.0.5: Progress view on send, default request headers — v1.0.4: Context menu on tabs (Close other/all tabs), minor improvements — v1.0.3: Pool thread for API invocation, 503 error handling — v1.0.2: JSON linter and formatter for request/response bodies — v1.0.1: Bug fix for 401 on POST — v1.0.0: Initial release
